## Scientific And Domain Assessments

### Qualified pooling and other-NCBI-taxa wording

consistency: concern. Targets: NCBITaxon:1906665.

The full 19-shard RS232 census (901,341 rows) supports all 299 selected GTDB species, their 711 distinct versioned catalog accessions, and every native cluster count. Complete reverse mappings contain 419 rows and match the set of source ncbi_taxid values for every cluster. BroadMatch represents pooling of several GTDB species onto the NCBI placeholder and is retained. The fixed other-NCBI-taxa clause is unsupported for 209 mappings: 187 singleton clusters and 22 multiple-member clusters whose members and sole reverse mapping all carry NCBITaxon:1906665. The other 90 clusters do contain other NCBI taxa. The primary Methanoprimaticola_hominis cluster has 49 members, of which 12 carry this exact NCBI taxid; the native attestation correctly uses whole-primary-cluster count 49 and notes 298 further clusters. Neither the sum 711 nor the 408 members carrying this target taxid nor the primary own-target subset 12 replaces that attestation.

### Five GTDB Bacteria classifications versus NCBI Archaea target identity

grounding: concern. Targets: NCBITaxon:1906665.

Five selected GTDB species have d__Bacteria classification despite including a catalog member whose ncbi_taxid and ncbi_species_taxid are 1906665 and whose catalog NCBI taxonomy is Archaea. These five target members are GB_GCA_021832035.1 in GTDB:s__JAJZAK01_sp021799485 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0005.jsonl.gz:27387); GB_GCA_048632225.1 in GTDB:s__E44-bin32_sp048629905 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0016.jsonl.gz:36978); GB_GCA_048634415.1 in GTDB:s__JAIVZN01_sp048634875 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0011.jsonl.gz:13289); GB_GCA_035528795.1 in GTDB:s__DATKXY01_sp035528795 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0009.jsonl.gz:44390); GB_GCA_048631505.1 in GTDB:s__UBA3076_sp048631505 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0001.jsonl.gz:30080). Their five clusters contain 14 members altogether. The native qualified mappings faithfully retain the conflicting source assertions. This is a source-taxonomy conflict concern, not a demonstrated seeder import defect or a claim that bacterial GTDB taxa are biologically within Archaea. No sequence, ANI or contamination analysis resolves which source classification should prevail.

### Primary-cluster units, source genome categories and culture boundary

evidence: supported. Targets: NCBITaxon:1906665.

Among the 711 selected catalog members, 677 explicitly say derived from metagenome, one says derived from single cell, and 33 have category none. The latter means unspecified here, not evidence for cultivated isolates. The single-cell member is GB_GCA_042584585.1 in GTDB:s__WALL01_sp042584585, isolate SAG AM-311-L14, at data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0017.jsonl.gz:45003. No culture deposit, phenotype, mechanism or experimental trait is inferred from an isolate label, MAG/SAG status or cluster membership. Versioned accessions are preserved, including GB_GCA_003661605.2; GCA and GCF forms are not collapsed into proven sequence equivalence. The primary Methanoprimaticola_hominis cluster has 49 members, of which 12 carry this exact NCBI taxid; the native attestation correctly uses whole-primary-cluster count 49 and notes 298 further clusters. Neither the sum 711 nor the 408 members carrying this target taxid nor the primary own-target subset 12 replaces that attestation.

- All 209 listed unsupported notes, comprising 187 singleton and 22 multiple-member same-target clusters, omit the unsupported other-taxa clause.

- Retain all 299 broadMatch mappings and correct cluster counts; retain primary attestation 49 GENOME and the 298-further-clusters note. Do not substitute 711, 408 or 12.
- Preserve the five cross-domain source conflicts explicitly without promoting qualified mappings into species equivalence or silently choosing a taxonomy.
- Change maintained inputs only; after authorized regeneration verify strict, history, product, corpus and QC gates.

### recover-pinned-aggregate-inputs

## Limits And Additional Notes

- Five selected GTDB species have d__Bacteria classification despite including a catalog member whose ncbi_taxid and ncbi_species_taxid are 1906665 and whose catalog NCBI taxonomy is Archaea. These five target members are GB_GCA_021832035.1 in GTDB:s__JAJZAK01_sp021799485 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0005.jsonl.gz:27387); GB_GCA_048632225.1 in GTDB:s__E44-bin32_sp048629905 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0016.jsonl.gz:36978); GB_GCA_048634415.1 in GTDB:s__JAIVZN01_sp048634875 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0011.jsonl.gz:13289); GB_GCA_035528795.1 in GTDB:s__DATKXY01_sp035528795 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0009.jsonl.gz:44390); GB_GCA_048631505.1 in GTDB:s__UBA3076_sp048631505 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0001.jsonl.gz:30080). Their five clusters contain 14 members altogether. The native qualified mappings faithfully retain the conflicting source assertions. This is a source-taxonomy conflict concern, not a demonstrated seeder import defect or a claim that bacterial GTDB taxa are biologically within Archaea. No sequence, ANI or contamination analysis resolves which source classification should prevail.
- GOLD 24 ORGANISM was checked as a pinned historical projection; no complete primary GOLD reconstruction or current organism census was performed.
- All 711 selected GTDB member identity, taxonomy and genome-category fields and all 419 reverse rows were inspected; the full 47-field technical metadata were additionally read for the 14 members of the five cross-domain clusters and the single-cell member. This does not claim exhaustive scientific reassessment of every technical field or current assembly, BioSample or BioProject authority for all 711 members.
- The complete census is of the pinned RS232 catalog, not a live worldwide genome inventory. Primary metadata preserve source classification and accession versions; no sequence alignment, ANI, contamination analysis or biological species-equivalence test was performed.
- No deposited culture, type strain, phenotype, protein function, regulation, pathway, causal graph or transcriptomic mechanism is inferred from catalog genome categories or isolate names. Optional inventory absences remain limited to the named pinned tables.
- Actual native gate execution at base 01ca63effdf8c03a644df893ba6129b2d8448ea4; retained original cwd, times, commands, log hashes and terminal exit codes identify the executions. Reused repository-wide receipts require the explicit same-base/native-input certificate; these are historical runs, not new batch-0018 invocations. Missing terminal receipts or reuse proof remain unavailable in unsaved previews. Exact-target strict receipts retain their original execution context. New review bundles still require individual validation/save/check.
- No generated record or history was edited; curation actions remain proposed.
- Fresh-base source transitions are verified against retained original captures and exact changed-input receipts.
- Every new bundle still requires its own validate/save/check recipe; historical native receipts do not claim these later steps have run.

assessments:
- assessment_id: archaeon-pooling-note-scope
  area: consistency
  topic: Qualified pooling and other-NCBI-taxa wording
  outcome: concern
  summary: 'The full 19-shard RS232 census (901,341 rows) supports all 299 selected
    GTDB species, their 711 distinct versioned catalog accessions, and every native
    cluster count. Complete reverse mappings contain 419 rows and match the set of
    source ncbi_taxid values for every cluster. BroadMatch represents pooling of several
    GTDB species onto the NCBI placeholder and is retained. The fixed other-NCBI-taxa
    clause is unsupported for 209 mappings: 187 singleton clusters and 22 multiple-member
    clusters whose members and sole reverse mapping all carry NCBITaxon:1906665. The
    other 90 clusters do contain other NCBI taxa. The primary Methanoprimaticola_hominis
    cluster has 49 members, of which 12 carry this exact NCBI taxid; the native attestation
    correctly uses whole-primary-cluster count 49 and notes 298 further clusters.
    Neither the sum 711 nor the 408 members carrying this target taxid nor the primary
    own-target subset 12 replaces that attestation.'
  target_ids:
  - NCBITaxon:1906665
  evidence_ids:
  - record
  - archaeon-reverse-mappings
  - archaeon-species-counts
  - archaeon-catalog-census
  - archaeon-mapping-policy

- assessment_id: archaeon-source-taxonomy-conflict
  area: grounding
  topic: Five GTDB Bacteria classifications versus NCBI Archaea target identity
  outcome: concern
  summary: Five selected GTDB species have d__Bacteria classification despite including
    a catalog member whose ncbi_taxid and ncbi_species_taxid are 1906665 and whose
    catalog NCBI taxonomy is Archaea. These five target members are GB_GCA_021832035.1
    in GTDB:s__JAJZAK01_sp021799485 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0005.jsonl.gz:27387);
    GB_GCA_048632225.1 in GTDB:s__E44-bin32_sp048629905 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0016.jsonl.gz:36978);
    GB_GCA_048634415.1 in GTDB:s__JAIVZN01_sp048634875 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0011.jsonl.gz:13289);
    GB_GCA_035528795.1 in GTDB:s__DATKXY01_sp035528795 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0009.jsonl.gz:44390);
    GB_GCA_048631505.1 in GTDB:s__UBA3076_sp048631505 (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0001.jsonl.gz:30080).
    Their five clusters contain 14 members altogether. The native qualified mappings
    faithfully retain the conflicting source assertions. This is a source-taxonomy
    conflict concern, not a demonstrated seeder import defect or a claim that bacterial
    GTDB taxa are biologically within Archaea. No sequence, ANI or contamination analysis
    resolves which source classification should prevail.
  target_ids:
  - NCBITaxon:1906665

- assessment_id: archaeon-source-unit-and-origin
  area: evidence
  topic: Primary-cluster units, source genome categories and culture boundary
  outcome: supported
  summary: Among the 711 selected catalog members, 677 explicitly say derived from
    metagenome, one says derived from single cell, and 33 have category none. The
    latter means unspecified here, not evidence for cultivated isolates. The single-cell
    member is GB_GCA_042584585.1 in GTDB:s__WALL01_sp042584585, isolate SAG AM-311-L14,
    at data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0017.jsonl.gz:45003. No culture deposit, phenotype,
    mechanism or experimental trait is inferred from an isolate label, MAG/SAG status
    or cluster membership. Versioned accessions are preserved, including GB_GCA_003661605.2;
    GCA and GCF forms are not collapsed into proven sequence equivalence. The primary
    Methanoprimaticola_hominis cluster has 49 members, of which 12 carry this exact
    NCBI taxid; the native attestation correctly uses whole-primary-cluster count
    49 and notes 298 further clusters. Neither the sum 711 nor the 408 members carrying
    this target taxid nor the primary own-target subset 12 replaces that attestation.
  target_ids:

- assessment_id: identity
  area: identity
  topic: Exact taxon and source lineage
  outcome: supported
  summary: NCBITaxon:1906665 denotes archaeon at SPECIES rank under NCBITaxon:93506,
    unclassified Archaea. The native label, genetic code 11 and all four carried ancestor
    IDs, literal labels and ranks agree with pinned NCBI and the current official
    EFetch; current LineageEx omits only root. This is an NCBI placeholder species-rank
    taxon, not an independently established formally named species. Native taxon_domain
    ARCHAEA follows its NCBI lineage. The separate NCBI administrative Division value
    Bacteria does not replace that lineage.
  target_ids:
  - NCBITaxon:1906665
  evidence_ids:
  - record
  - taxonomy-inventory
  - ncbi-live
  - scope-row
  - path-row
  - archaeon-target-identity
  - archaeon-current-ncbi
  dimensions:

- assessment_id: taxonomy-mapping
  area: grounding
  topic: Qualified species mapping and target scope
  outcome: concern
  summary: 'The full 19-shard RS232 census (901,341 rows) supports all 299 selected
    GTDB species, their 711 distinct versioned catalog accessions, and every native
    cluster count. Complete reverse mappings contain 419 rows and match the set of
    source ncbi_taxid values for every cluster. BroadMatch represents pooling of several
    GTDB species onto the NCBI placeholder and is retained. The fixed other-NCBI-taxa
    clause is unsupported for 209 mappings: 187 singleton clusters and 22 multiple-member
    clusters whose members and sole reverse mapping all carry NCBITaxon:1906665. The
    other 90 clusters do contain other NCBI taxa. The primary Methanoprimaticola_hominis
    cluster has 49 members, of which 12 carry this exact NCBI taxid; the native attestation
    correctly uses whole-primary-cluster count 49 and notes 298 further clusters.
    Neither the sum 711 nor the 408 members carrying this target taxid nor the primary
    own-target subset 12 replaces that attestation. Five selected GTDB species have
    d__Bacteria classification despite including a catalog member whose ncbi_taxid
    and ncbi_species_taxid are 1906665 and whose catalog NCBI taxonomy is Archaea.
    These five target members are GB_GCA_021832035.1 in GTDB:s__JAJZAK01_sp021799485
    (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0005.jsonl.gz:27387); GB_GCA_048632225.1 in GTDB:s__E44-bin32_sp048629905
    (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0016.jsonl.gz:36978); GB_GCA_048634415.1 in GTDB:s__JAIVZN01_sp048634875
    (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0011.jsonl.gz:13289); GB_GCA_035528795.1 in GTDB:s__DATKXY01_sp035528795
    (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0009.jsonl.gz:44390); GB_GCA_048631505.1 in GTDB:s__UBA3076_sp048631505
    (data/catalog/gtdb_genomes-0001.jsonl.gz:30080). Their five clusters contain 14
    members altogether. The native qualified mappings faithfully retain the conflicting
    source assertions. This is a source-taxonomy conflict concern, not a demonstrated
    seeder import defect or a claim that bacterial GTDB taxa are biologically within
    Archaea. No sequence, ANI or contamination analysis resolves which source classification
    should prevail.'
  target_ids:
  - NCBITaxon:1906665

- finding_id: pooled-note-other-taxa
  issue_key: gtdb-broadmatch-note-other-taxa-1906665
  category: consistency
  severity: minor
  status: open
  certainty: confirmed
  title: 209 pooled GTDB notes incorrectly assert other NCBI taxa
  description: 'The full 19-shard RS232 census (901,341 rows) supports all 299 selected
    GTDB species, their 711 distinct versioned catalog accessions, and every native
    cluster count. Complete reverse mappings contain 419 rows and match the set of
    source ncbi_taxid values for every cluster. BroadMatch represents pooling of several
    GTDB species onto the NCBI placeholder and is retained. The fixed other-NCBI-taxa
    clause is unsupported for 209 mappings: 187 singleton clusters and 22 multiple-member
    clusters whose members and sole reverse mapping all carry NCBITaxon:1906665. The
    other 90 clusters do contain other NCBI taxa. The primary Methanoprimaticola_hominis
    cluster has 49 members, of which 12 carry this exact NCBI taxid; the native attestation
    correctly uses whole-primary-cluster count 49 and notes 298 further clusters.
    Neither the sum 711 nor the 408 members carrying this target taxid nor the primary
    own-target subset 12 replaces that attestation. The exact affected source IDs
    are enumerated in field_paths; each corresponding full primary cluster and complete
    reverse inventory has only NCBITaxon:1906665. The seeder currently adds the clause
    for any broadMatch without testing this second mapping direction.'
